name: buildbetter
description: Use BuildBetter's MCP server, bb CLI, and product-operations skills from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use BuildBetter MCP and bb CLI
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to BuildBetter's MCP server for product evidence, customer voice, synthetic research, native surveys, Smart Tags, project triage, knowledge gaps, and organization-aware workflows. The bundled skills also document local bb CLI setup, health checks, feedback hooks, and plugin sharing/submission steps.

Use BuildBetter to run a bounded synthetic persona study.

Use BuildBetter to create and evaluate a Smart Tag.
Use BuildBetter to inspect project triage and knowledge gaps.
Check bb CLI health and install hooks for this repo.
